description: React component implementing a multi-step form wizard with validation, controlled inputs, and review/edit capabilities.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the current step or a target step, returning true if validation passes and setting error states as needed.

methods.name: computeS1
methods.description: Computes the validity of step 1 based on username, password, and confirm password.

methods.name: computeS2
methods.description: Computes the validity of step 2 based on first name, last name, and email.

methods.name: computeS3
methods.description: Computes the validity of step 3 based on topic and delivery frequency.

methods.name: goToStep
methods.description: Navigates to a specified step after validating prior steps.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step if the current step is valid.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: markTyping
methods.description: Marks the user as currently typing and sets a debounce timer to reset it.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, updates form data, and triggers debounce validation.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events on input fields, primarily to freeze validation visuals during focus.

methods.name: onBlurField
methods.description: Handles blur events, triggers validation for the specific step and field.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enables editing for a specific review section, setting the step to the section number.

methods.name: saveFromEdit
methods.description: Validates and saves changes made during section editing, returning to review step.

methods.name: canProceed
methods.description: Determines if the user can proceed to the next step based on cached validation states.
